purpose: New bounded, distinct spot and binary strategies; research/paper only; no broker integration or live execution

crypto.data: Checksum verified Binance monthly spot 1m January2025-October2026; complete UTC resampling; gap resets; no volume assumption
crypto.confirmation_scope: Only newly collected BNB XRP ADA, and only the validation-selected global configuration. Existing BTC ETH SOL dates were already evaluated elsewhere. Correlated new assets are retrospective transfer evidence, not independent prospective proof.
crypto.rules: Long-only. All require EMA50>EMA200 and close>EMA200. breakout20: close crosses above previous20-bar high. pullback20: previous low touches previous EMA20 and previous close<=EMA20, current close crosses above EMA20 with green body. trend_cross: EMA20 crosses above EMA50 with green body. Warmup250 closed requested candles; indicator state resets on gaps.
crypto.execution: Decision after close; entry next observed minute open. Stop2ATR14 below observed entry; target1.5R/2R above. ATR is Wilder14. Max12 requested candles held. Check minute OHLC, gap through stop fills at open, adverse stop-first if both touched. Target fills at limit, never favorable gap-price improvement. No same-minute entry after exit; no overlaps per asset, flat original risk1unit per trade, no compounding/shared-equity claim. Exit before split/gap/end; reject trades lacking full holding horizon inside split and contiguous source.
crypto.benchmarks: Same execution, costs, ATR, exits and no-overlap rules for always-long and EMA200 trend-long entries for each timeframe/target. Buy-and-hold net period return also disclosed but is not risk matched.
crypto.selection: Validation>=200trades,>=30activeUTCdays,profitfactor>=1.10,netR>0,positive netR in>=4of6assets,Bonferroni-adjusted lower day-cluster-bootstrap mean>0 using5000 resamples/12 candidates,positive combined delayed+high-cost stress netR, outperform both risk-matched benchmarks in mean netR/trade. Rank adjusted bootstrap lower then config ID. Freeze one choice before any confirmation evaluation; do not replace if final fails.
crypto.confirmation_gate: Only selected config on new3assets;>=100trades,>=20activeUTCdays,PF>=1.10,positive 95% day-cluster-bootstrap lower mean,positive net in>=2assets,positive combined stress,meanR/trade above both risk-matched baselines. Otherwise no qualified model. No tuning after final.

pocket_option.source: Existing user's complete5s OHLC archive; observed historically; no pristine or executable quote claim
pocket_option.rules: EMA20/50, ATR14,60bar warmup. breakout20: closed break of prior20high/low alignedEMA20/50. pullback20: closed reclaim/cross ofEMA20 after prior wick touch alignedEMA20/50. range_reclaim: prior close outside SMA20 +/-2populationSD, current close back inside with reversal body and abs(EMA20-EMA50)<ATR14. Mirrored CALL/PUT. Exact next observed5s open, no overlaps, no gap/split crossing, ties refund, fixed1unit stake.
pocket_option.reserved: Do not evaluate previously reserved period after2026-10-05T18:10:50Z in this round. Even a promising historical candidate requires new prospective broker quotes/payouts over>=30days.
pocket_option.stress: Combined entry delayed5s AND adverse entry1bp; expiry follows actual entry; exactobserved settlement
pocket_option.historical_gate: >=200decidedtrades,>=3days,Wilsonlower>55.56%,nominal binomialp<.05/12,adjusted lower daily-bootstrap mean80>0,positive combinedstress80,>=2profitableassets. Rank adjusted bootstrap lower. Historical pass is not live approval.

prohibited_claims: prospective/unseen market regime from correlated assets
trained AI model from deterministic rules
deployment: No production strategy changes, extension upload, live hosting changes or real orders. Save results and a paper-only causal signal interface.
